description: 2022 bikeable road network for Greater Melbourne classified by bike infrastructure and bike LTS is a data set deposited in Monash University by its authors Debjit Bhowmick, Ben Beck. Bicycling Level of Traffic Stress (LTS)The Bicycling Level of Traffic Stress (LTS) is a framework that categorizes road segments based on the level of stress they induce in people riding bikes. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 221683712 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
